context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 19 features fully functional. 1) Finance Reset: POST /api/finance/reset-all with {confirm:'RESET'} clears all invoices, payments, allocations, credit notes and resets student balances. UI has Reset All Billing button (data-testid='reset-billing-btn') that opens confirmation dialog requiring user to type 'RESET'. 2) Term Broadcast: PUT /api/settings/active-term now broadcasts 'term_changed' WebSocket event to ALL connected users via ws_manager.broadcast_all(). TermContext.js listens for this event and auto-updates activeTerm/academicYear. Term selector in Topbar (data-testid='term-selector') allows SuperAdmin/CEO/Admin to change term.
